prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunlit white-washed courtyard with a pale tiled floor, an arched doorway at normal height, low stone steps and a waist-high wall, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Pakistani person with a handsome man's face on a full, curvaceous female body — a man in his early 30s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a clean-cut young male model face with defined cheekbones, a firm jaw and strong straight brows, clean-shaven, pearly white eyeshadow with a clear gloss lip and soft blush, smooth light-brown skin with a warm undertone, a soft amused smile, soft pastel-peach hair styled in elegant updo, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large gold hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a gold chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a tin pyramid-shaped lump), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and four to six layered platinum rings. Extra long nails in matching polished labradorite.

LEFT Body Art: full body polished labradorite fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is solid stone curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted stone sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING dark grey labradorite surface across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID electric blue and gold flashes shimmering through every section, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. RIGHT: ONE real adult Uzbek man in his early 30s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a fresh-faced boy-group idol face with clear glowing skin, bright eyes and a gentle smile line, clean-shaven, copper-bronze smoky eyes with a golden highlight, fair olive skin with a warm undertone, a cool composed look, cool ash-brown hair styled in a mohawk with volume along the centre of the scalp, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large platinum hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on platinum chains of different lengths (a silver small flared temple bell, a tin hammer head), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large copper hoop carrying six heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on copper chains of different lengths (a gold square-sided cowbell, a gold cube-shaped block, a copper ship's anchor, a gold barrel-shaped weight, a gold chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a copper hammer head), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten silver hair ornaments. Extremely long almond nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful man, far beyond any real person. A massive V-shaped torso: enormously broad shoulders with capped, rounded deltoids, a thick heavy chest, a deeply carved six-pack abdomen narrowing to a comparatively small waist, huge thick arms with split biceps and horseshoe triceps, wide flaring lats, and powerful thick quads and diamond calves. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing nothing but a white leather mankini of two narrow straps rising over his shoulders from a small opaque pouch at the front, thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering him.
RIGHT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of his body.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
